Named in 22 Google reviews RDA-OA Lead Instructor Jessica Jessica has worked in dentistry since 2015 and is a Roseville Dental Academy graduate. After completing the program and earning her x-ray license, she was hired at Waikiki Dental, grew through chairside, co-assisting, and patient administration roles, and discovered a passion for helping interns learn with confidence. Roseville Dental Academy alumna RDA since 2017 Orthodontic Assistant permit CPR/BLS instructor since 2019 WHAT STUDENTS SAY ABOUT JESSICA “I graduated from Roseville Dental Academy and professor Jessica is the best.” Ñåwìd Žãźāį · Jan 30, 2026 “Roseville Academy is the best place, Jessica is the best teacher and teaches the best lessons.” Diamond Zamzam · Jan 27, 2026 “Excellent dental assisting program with hands-on training and great support. Jessica is an outstanding instructor.” Selene · Jan 26, 2026 RDAEF2 Instructor Sajal Sajal brings advanced dental training and a careful, compassionate teaching style to the academy. His approach combines technical precision, patient care habits, and mentorship so students can build dependable clinical skills. RDAEF2 instructor Advanced clinical training Mentorship-focused Patient-care oriented RDA Instructor Katelyn Katelyn attended Roseville Dental Academy in 2021 after moving from Indiana and has built her career around dental assisting and student support. She enjoys helping future dental assistants feel capable, prepared, and ready for the office. Roseville Dental Academy alumna Registered Dental Assistant Dental hygiene student Confidence-building coach Named in 2 Google reviews Instructor Sandra Sandra teaches alongside Jessica in the 9-week Dental Assisting program. Graduates mention her by name in their Google reviews for patient, clear, hands-on instruction. Dental Assisting program instructor Named in student reviews Patient, hands-on coaching WHAT STUDENTS SAY ABOUT SANDRA “Sandra and Jessica are very nice, patient, and teach very well.” Kate Richard · Dec 19, 2025 “In just 9 weeks, I’ve learned an incredible amount under the guidance of Jessica, Sandra, and Bri.” Jocelin Avalos · Jan 27, 2024 ALSO ON THE TEAM Dr. Michael Narodovich — “Dr. Mike” Students train inside Waikiki Dental, and Dr. Mike also offers custom, one-on-one implant and bone grafting coaching for dentists — CBCT-guided and free-hand implant placement, bone grafting, and crestal sinus augmentation, hands-on with your own patients. Ask about coaching HOW WE TEACH Coaching you can feel on day one Hands-on first Training is delivered in a working office environment so students build habits that match real patient care and day-to-day operations. Smaller classroom feel The academy keeps groups smaller to improve teacher-to-student focus and make skills coaching more direct. Practical outcomes Students train toward the same goal each day: building the habits and skills dental offices expect from entry-level hires.
